basic_info.description: Experience iconic San Francisco living from this 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom condo with breathtaking views of Alcatraz, Angel Island, and the Bay. This unit is located in a classic 1907 building, the 1,419 sq ft (per tax) residence features recently refinished floors, a semi-open floor plan in the living areas and sweeping views from the kitchen, dining, and living rooms. The unit is complete with a walk-out deck featuring a gas firepit to enjoy cozy nights under the stars overlooking the glistening San Francisco Bay. The home includes 1-carport parking for added convenience. With a Walk Score of 97 and a Transit Score of 82, this location is ideally located to explore the surrounding neighborhoods or for convenient commutes downtown. Just steps from Ghirardelli Square, Aquatic Park, Fort Mason, and Francisco Park - enjoy all the area has to offer on foot! With premier access to the Marina Green, Polk Street shops, and world-class dining.
